purpose: City-specific official registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review.
assessment: A city-operated polygon layer returned one parcel intersecting the exact ranked WUP point, with the source-native safe parcel key and full geometry. Only one polygon is retained. The point is a population-weighted locator, not a boundary; this sample does not establish completeness, data currency, legal status or runtime contract.
registryAssessment: The Hellenic Cadastre announced the Thessaloniki Cadastral Office and local jurisdiction. The official Thessaloniki municipal ArcGIS layer “Γεωτεμάχια Κτηματολογίου - ΚΑΕΚ” is a polygon layer with safe native identifier KAEK and supports GeoJSON queries. An exact ranked-point query returned one full polygon; this establishes a sampled feature only, not citywide completeness or runtime readiness.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Hellenic Cadastre announcement says Thessaloniki Cadastral Office began operation 2024-04-01 and lists its jurisdiction.
Official Hellenic Cadastre INSPIRE information says cadastral boundaries can be publicly viewed/downloaded without registration.

Official Thessaloniki city ArcGIS metadata: Polygon Feature Layer, EPSG:2100, extent covers the WUP point; query formats JSON/GeoJSON; safe fields OBJECTID and KAEK plus geometry; no personal fields listed.

serviceChecks.observation: Exact ranked-point query returned one polygon; only safe native parcel key KAEK=190442128009 and geometry were retained. Source OBJECTID was not copied into sample.

privacy: Only safe source-native parcel identifiers and geometry are retained where returned. No owner, address, title, account or tax data were requested.

remainingUncertainty: The city layer’s maintenance/currentness, exact legal relationship to the national cadastre, full city coverage and native CRS/query contract outside the point response remain to be qualified.
